non_negotiables.rule: Human approval before any proposal submission (two explicit confirmations: submit, then confirm after preview).
Never auto-buy Connects; never boost above 10 Connects; never auto-reply to clients; never accept offers automatically.
No fabricated credentials, client names or results; placeholders and VERIFY LIVE tags instead.
Claims hygiene: no "8 years", no GxP/HIPAA/compliance absolutes, no "enterprise-grade", no guarantees.
OpenClaw is never in the storefront; MCP is a keyword, not the headline.
The MCP engine is never mentioned in client-facing text as Upwork automation.
State, logs and client data live outside the repo (%USERPROFILE%\upwork_engine\).
Every MCP call logged with input parameters and execution state; comprehensive try/except with classified incidents.
Deterministic rules live in versioned config (campaigns.json, scoring.json); agents never edit them at run time.
Reassess after 20–30 qualified proposals; one experiment at a time; one scoring block re-weighted per month.
